messages:
sarah: Quick sync — final call on the release note copy and pinning before we trigger deploybot. Target change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Can owners confirm pinned versions and rollback plan?
jeff: I reviewed RN draft, looks good. We should pin service-api to `api@2026.3.11` and model to `redwood-serve-v1.8-q3`.
maria: Confirmed pin for model and api. Adding a tiny blurb about the KV cache improvement (will be visible for long tail latency).
ops-oncall: 👍 noted. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to `api@2026.2.28` + model fallback to `redwood-serve-v1.7`. Will need DB feature-flag toggle script ready.
sarah: Thanks. Can someone paste the exact deploybot cue we should use? Want the canned message to be copy/pasted into the channel so deploy-bot picks it up.
jeff: Use: `@deploy-bot deploy release=2026.03.11 pins=api@2026.3.11,model@redwood-serve-v1.8-q3 window=02:00-03:00-UTC`
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: release=2026.03.11; pins=[api@2026.3.11, model@redwood-serve-v1.8-q3]; window=02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary targets: staging then eu1 then global. Reaction required: ops-oncall, nate.
ops-oncall: Reacting with :white_check_mark:. I'll own the DB toggle and monitor.
nate: I'll run the smoke test matrix at +10m post canary and post logs here. If latency > 95th baseline or error rate spikes, we'll hit rollback.
maria: Also updating the internal announce to call out potential transient embedding reranking diffs — ops to watch embeddings request queue.
sarah: Perfect. I'll publish RN snippets to the internal blast doc now and pin this thread. Please DM me if you spot copy errors. :thumbsup:
jeff: One last note — add a short line in RN about the automated prefix cache invalidation; ops will have the script name `cache-inv-cli --release 2026.03.11`.
sarah: Added. Deploybot, stand by for the `deploy` command in 20m after the quiet window check.
deploy-bot: reminder: next deploy slot at 02:00 UTC. Send `@deploy-bot deploy ...` to start.
